newsitem.title: USA: USSB extends satellite TV coupon offer.
newsitem.headline: USSB extends satellite TV coupon offer.

text.p: U.S. Satellite Broadcasting System said Monday it was extending a coupon offer for buyers of digital satellite system (DSS) dishes.

USSB, which provides DSS television programming, said it extended an offer through the end of the year under which buyers of any brand of 18-inch DSS dish will receive $200 in coupons, including discounts on USSB's pay-per-view events and special channels.

Beginning August 29, DSS buyers will also be eligible for cash back from DIRECTV, a subsidiary of Hughes Electronics Corp, also provides satellite programming. DIRECTV and USSB programming do not overlap, USSB said.
DSS dishes are manufactured by various consumer electronics companies, such as Sony Corp and General Electric Co.
